description: This PHP file defines the 'Extension' class within the namespace 'Opencart\Admin\Controller\Startup'. The class contains a method 'index' that loads extension settings from the database and registers associated extension components, such as controllers, models, libraries, templates, languages, and configurations, into the system autoloader and path managers.

classes.name: Extension
classes.description: Controller class responsible for initializing and registering extension components during system startup.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Loads extension settings from the database and registers extension components such as controllers, models, libraries, templates, languages, and configuration paths.
